status: Source/synthetic protocol; root must separately freeze source/input maps and execution_ready before any actual run. All settings were specified by root before these numerical results.

fixed_policy.contexts: Six canonical refit contexts: c0full120 resubstitution and c1..c5 own96-training/24-OOF evaluations. The five outer evaluation cohorts partition original120 once.
fixed_policy.choice: Reuse each canonical context exact selected release/forecast tuple and ownQ1 target, including an initialReview if no candidate was selected. No inner re-selection, menu/target refit, new family or favorable-context substitution.
fixed_policy.case: Q1 Review/nonBalanced and dynamic initialReview remain separately labeledNULL, never replaced with bills, B or a different candidate.
fixed_policy.pending: The unchanged V2b one-time mitigation then absorbing pending rule, original CPI/peak/MDD/H and all remaining physical exposure are retained.
fixed_policy.admission_interpretation: This stresses an already selected candidate and its fixed initial feasibility rule, not the stability of refitting/reselecting/reapproving the entire learner.

base_gate.order: Preflight all source/input and complete canonical output hashes, then guarded load1-120 only. Reproduce baseline for all6contexts×4objects before any nonbase setting is evaluated.
base_gate.objects: Canonical selected learner arm and same_target_B, same_target_annual, exact_thirds_annual per context.
base_gate.exact: For every retained canonical array compare fieldnames, dtype, shape and values exactly with pairedNaNs treated equal. No scalar/array tolerance, dropped field or different comparator allowed. InitialNULL matches absent arms.
base_gate.thinning_order: Compare the full canonical selected/reference arm first; only afterward apply uniform stress-archive thinning.
base_gate.receipt: Write base_reproduction_receipt.json and itsSHA into runningmanifest before permitting fee/support/inflation stresses. Any mismatch fails the immutable attempt without reading/running nonbase outcomes.

stress_meaning.known_fees: Fees0/.00125/.0025/.005/.01 are known identically to the decision model, actual trade accounting and all references. Actions and fees may change jointly. This does not test fee misestimation, refitted targets or approval robustness.
stress_meaning.pooled_support: Replace calendar safety support by all chronological training-year joint real-gross rows. Growth forecasts retain original calendar rows and fixed forecast rule. No training row is dropped for low forecast probability. Broader support may refuse initial investment; that yieldsNULLfinancialrisk, not zero risk.
stress_meaning.inflation: Add+.02 to every actual annual inflation decimal, meaning+2percentagepoints, with nominal assetreturns unchanged and training fan/support/scale unchanged. Later actual observations legitimately change next decisions; no actual current/future shock is supplied to the decision before its time. The original CPI and real peak evolve normally.
stress_meaning.initial_and_terminal: Initial allocation is charged at the setting fee before current returns. No later deposits/withdrawals or terminal liquidation cost is added.
stress_meaning.guard_scope: Empirical one-step support or net worst-nextwealth improvement remains conditional, not a real-world floor guarantee or a future10%risk certificate.

outputs.summary: Exactly7settings×2cohorts×4objects=56rows. Perobject original120 IDs retained once in outerOOF and separately once in fullresubstitution; no pooling of these two cohorts.
outputs.paths: 7×2×4×120=6720 rows, including all initialReview NULLs and all funded pending outcomes.
outputs.comparisons: 42setting/cohort/reference groups: all-original reference and same-funded-ID model/reference summaries; complete event-ID partitions, rejectedIDs and6paired metrics(logG,CAGR,MDD,fees,tradefraction,automaticfraction). Empty cohorts allNULL.
outputs.archive: 168 metadata groups; uniformly omit candidate_* and mitigation_candidate_* alternative menus plus shared training_previous_state/training_real_gross copies. Preserve every other physical/selectedscalar array, actualpreviousstate and realizedrealgross; omittednames are declared.

canonical_reuse: Rows, NULL rows and financial summaries explicitly call the unchanged run_state_budget_mitigation helpers. References use the exact same paired simulator and squeeze helper with the setting known fee.
failure_and_lineage: A separate docs/state_budget_mitigation_stress_source_freeze.json must bind protocolSHA, all source files, all declaredinputs and canonicalclosure; execution_ready=true required before raw/canonicalarrayparsing. Existingoutput directories are never overwritten. Every failure preserves failedmanifest andtraceback. Start/end canonical bytes and all source/input hashes are checked.
interpretation: New descriptive development stresses of frozen-selected V2b, designed after earlier adverseV2/V2b findings. No new final121-180 read, no winner selected from stresses and no older negative evidence erased. Do not confuse widespread funded referrals with useful continuous autonomous service.
